title: The yaml block of a layout 2 review finding

repo.description: The repository the finding is in, as named in the review header's commits.

concern.description: spec: the change disagrees with the spec or plan; bug: wrong behavior the spec does not cover; convention: the change breaks a written rule of its repository.

rule.description: For a convention finding, the written rule it breaks: <file>:<line> in the repository, or a linter's rule ID.
